## Overview

ECTP is an international conference devoted to measurement and modeling of thermophysical properties. The scope includes a range of thermal and radiative properties and associated experimental techniques. Emissivity-related work appears in sessions addressing radiative heat transfer and optical/radiative characterization of materials.
